a: दासी — 1 A female servant or slave. --2 The wife of a fisherman. --3 The wife of a Śūdra. --4 An altar. --5 A harlot. --Comp. --पुत्रः, --सुतः the son of a female slave. --श्रोत्रियः a Brāhmaṇa (knowing the Vedas) attached to a female slave. --सभं a collection of female slaves. (The gen. sing. दास्याः enters into some compounds, but loses its literal sense; e. g. दास्याःपुत्रः, --सुतः ‘a whore-son’, used as a term of abuse; दास्याःपुत्रैः शकुनिलुब्धकैः Ś. 2; but दास्याः सदृशी ‘like a female slave’).

pramucyate । nigrahAdbaqavAyAstu mucyate baqavABftaH” iti । etaduktaM Bavati durBikze pozaRena kArito dAso goyugmArpaRAnmucyate । Ahita dAsastu svAminA gfhIte fRe pratyarpite sati uttamarRadAsyAdvimucyate । fRadAsastu svakftamfRaM yenottamarRAya yAvadDanandattvApAkftaM tasmE tAvadDanaM savfdDikaM dattvA vimucyaye । tavAhamityupagatAdayastrayodAsAH svanirvarttya svIyavyApAranirvarttakadAsAntarapradAnAdvimucyante । kftakAlastu dAso dAsyAvaDitvena pariBAzitakAlasyAtikramaRAdvimucyate । BaktadAsastu BaktasyotkzepaRAdBakzitaBaktamUlyasamarpaRAdvimucyate । gfhadAsIloBena dAsatvaM prAptastatsamBogatyAgAdvimucyata iti । balAtdAsIkftAnAntyAgamAha yAjYavalkyaH “balAddAsIkftaScOrErvikrItaScApi mucyate” iti । apiSabdena dattAhitO gfhyete । tataScAyamarTaH । balAtkAreRa yo dAsIkftaH yaSca cOrErapahftya dAsatvena bikrIta Ahitodatto vA sa yasya pArSve dAsaBAvena tizWati tena prAgukta mocanahetumantareREva SIGraM mocanIya ityarTaH । yadi tena loBAdivaSAdasO na muktastadA rAjYA mocayitavya ityAha nAradaH “cOrApahftavikrItA ye ca dAsIkftA balAt । rAjYA mocayitavyAste dAsyantezu hi nezyate” iti । cOreRApahftASca te vikrItASceti karmaDArayaH । yastvekasya dAsyaM pUrvamaNgIkftyAparasyApi dAsatvamaNgIkaroti asAvapareRApi vivarjanIya iti sa evAha । “tavAhamiti cAtmAnaM yo'svatantraH prayacCati । na sa taM prApnuyAtkAmaM pUrvasvAmI laBeta tamiti” । asvatantraH paradAsatvenAsvatantraH kAmaM nUtanasvAmidAsyaM kAmyamAnam itaradAsIBavantaM dAsaM pUrvasvAmI gfhRIyAdityarTaH । eva yadetaddAsamaDikftyoktantatsarvaM dAsyAmapi samAnanyAyatvAd yojanIyam । dAsIsvAminamaDikftya viSezamAha kAtyAyanaH “svAM dAsIM yastu saNgacCet prasUtA ca gavettataH । avekzya vIjaM kAryyA syAdadAsI sAnvayA tu seti” । svakftagarBADAnamanusanDAya sA dAsI santAna sahitA dAsatvavimokaviDinA svakftagarBAderdAsatvaparihArArTaM adAsItvena kAryyA syAdityarTaH । kaH punardAsatvavimocakoviDirityAkANkzAyAmAha nAradaH “svandAsamicCed yaH kartumadAsaM prItamAnasaH । skanDAdAdAya tasyAsO BindyAt kumBaM sahAmBasA । sAkzatABiH sapuzpABirmUrdDanyadBiravAkiret । adAsa iti cIktvA triH prANmuKantamaTotsfjediti” । atrApi dAsaSabdena dAsyA api grahaRam liNgasyoddeSyaviSezaRatvena grahADikaraRanyAyenAvivakzitatvAt । evamutsarge sati yadBavati tadAha sa eva “tataH praBfti vaktavyaH svAmyanugrahapAlitaH । BojyAnno'pyapratigrAhyo BavatyaBimataH satAmiti” । svAmyanugraheRa dAsyApAkaraRarUpeRa vaktavyaH samBAzaRArhaH । adAsyA api dAsena pariRitAyA dAsItvameva BavatItyAha kAtyAyanaH “dAsenoQA tvadAsI yA sApi dAsItvamApnuyAt । yasmAdBarttA praBustasyAH svAmyaDInaH praBuryataH” iti । dAsaDanasyApi tatsvAmiDanatvamityAha sa eva “dAsasya tu DanaM yatsyAt svAmI tasya praBuH smftaH” iti । brAhmaRyAdizu dAsIkaraRe daRqamAha kAtyAyanaH “AdadyAd brahmARIM yastu vikrIRIta taTEva ca । rAjYA tadakftaM kAryaM daRqyAH syuH sarva eva te । kAmAttu saSritAM yastu kuryyAddAsIM kulastriyam । saMkrAmayan taTAnyatra daRqyAstaccAkftamBavet । bAlaDAtrImadAsIYca dAsImiva Bunakti yaH । paricArakapatnIM vA prApnuyAtpUrvasAhasamiti” । tatkAryaM akfta nivartanIyamityarTaH । tena rAjYA daRqyAH syurinvayaH । vizRurapi “yastUttamavarRaM dAsye niyojayati tasyottamasAhasodaRqa” iti । kvaciddAsIvikrayaRe daRqamAha kAtyAyanaH “vikroSamAnAM yo BaktAM dAsIM vikretumicCati । anApadisTaH SaktaH san prApnuyAt dviSataM damamiti” । dviSataM paRAnAmiti SezaH । BaktAmityanena duzwAyA vikrayaRe daRqABAva iti darSitamiti” । “cUqAdyA yadi saMskArA nijagotreRa vE kftAH । dattAdyAstanayAste syuranyaTA dAsa ucyate” kAlikApurARokte nijagotreRa saMskAraM vinA gfhIte 7 dattakAdO ca tezAM ca dAsavadBaraRIyatayA taTAtvam dattakaSabde mUlaM dfSyam । striyAM NIp । dAsa--upakzepe ac । 8 upakzepake tri॰ । 9 vftrAsure pu॰ dAsapatnISabde dfSyam । 10 dasyO ca dAsaveSaSabde dfSyam । dAsasvApatyaM naqA॰ Pak । dAsAyana dAsApatye puMstrI॰ । dAsa + BfSA॰ aBUtatadBAve kyaN । dAsAyate adAso dAso BavatItyarTaH । adAsaM dAsaM karotyarTe cvikfYAdyanu prayogaH adAso dAso Bavati dAsIBavati adAsaM dAsaM karoti dAsIkarotItyAdi saMjYAyAM kan । dAsaka gotrapravarttakarziBede tasya gotrApatyam aSvA॰ Paka । dAsakAyana tadgotrApatye puMstrI ।
m: 1. दास m. fiend, demon
N. of certain evil beings conquered by Indra (e.g. Namuci, Pipru, Śambara, Varcin &c.), RV.
savage, barbarian, infidel (also दास, opp. to आर्य; cf. दस्यु)
slave, servant, RV.; AV.; Mn. &c.
a Śūdra, L., Sch.
one to whom gifts may be made, W.
a fisherman (v.l. for दाश)
दास mfn. ifc. of names, esp. of Śūdras and Kāya-sthas (but cf. also कालि-)
दास mf(ई)n. fiendish, demoniacal, barbarous, impious, RV.
2. दास m. a knowing man, esp. a knower of the universal spirit, L.
a: दासः — 1 A slave, servant in general; गृहकर्मदासाः Bh. 1. 1; गृह˚, कर्म˚ &c. --2 A fisherman. --3 A Śūdra, a man of the fourth caste. --4 A knowing man, one who knows the universal spirit. --5 N. of Vṛtrāsura. --6 A demon. --7 A savage, barbarian (opp. आर्य). --8 A worthy recipient (दानपात्र). --9 A word added to the name of a Śūdra; cf. गुप्त. --Comp. --अनुदासः ‘a slave of a slave’, the humblest of the servants; (sometimes used by the speaker as a mark of humility). --जनः a servant or slave; कमपराधलवं मयि पश्यसि त्यजसि मानिनि दासजनं यतः V. 4. 29; (दासस्यकुलं is used as a compound in the sense of ‘the mob or the common people’). --भावः servitude.

m: दास—भार्य ii. sg. servants and wives, ChUp. vii, 24, 2.
दास—भाव m. condition of a slave, servitude, MBh.
दास—शर्मन् m. N. of a Sch. on ŚāṅkhŚr.
दास—शिरस् & दास—सरस, n. N. of two Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.
दास—दासी f. the female slave of a slave, Mn. ix, 179
दास—दासी—जन m. a male and a female slave, VarBṛ. li, 25.
दास—जीवन mfn. living like a slave, Mn. x, 32.
दास—जन m. slave, servant, Kālid.; Kathās. &c.
दास˚कायन m. patr. fr. दासक, ib.
दासक m. N. of a man (cf. दाश्˚) g. अश्वादि
दास—कर्म-कर m. a servant doing his work, Āp.
दास—केतु m. N. of a son of Manu Dakṣasāvarṇa, VP. iii, 2, 23.

दास—मिथुन n. a couple of slaves, KātyŚr.; Lāṭy.; Mn.
दास—मि˚त्रायण & दास—मि˚त्रि, m. descendant of Dāsa-mitra (-भक्त n. the district inhabited by them g. ऐषुकार्य्-आदि)
दास—मि˚त्रायण—भक्त n., the district inhabited by descendants of दास-मित्र, g. ऐषुकार्य्-आदि

strI ba॰ va॰ । dAsayati dAsa--upakzepe ac dAsIvfttAsuraH patiryAsAm । 1 apsu । “dAsapatnIrahigopA atizWan” f॰ 1 । 32 । 11 “dAsI viSvopakzapaRaheturvftraH patiH svAmI yAsAmapAM tA dAsapatnIH । dAsapatnIH dasu upakzaye dAsayatItiM dAsovftraH pacAdyac । cita ityantodAttatvam । dAsaH patiryAsAM “viBAzA sapUrvasya” pA॰ NIp tatsaMniyogenekarisya nakAraH bahubrIhO pUrvapadaprakftisvaratvam” BA॰ । “aSvinAvindumamftaM vfttaBUyO tiroDattAmaSvinO dAsapatnIH” BA॰ A॰ 3 a॰ । 6 ta॰ dAsamya patnIva dAsastriyAYca sarvavacanam ।

tri, dADAtoH karmmaRi syamAnapratyayena nizyannaH । BavizyaddAnasambanDivastu । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ “api ca UnaviMSatidAsyamAna piRqasTAnAni yaTA .” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥
